generic_sampling_rules.int_primary_key: Sequential integers starting at max(compact PK)+1, unique per table, never NULL; generated PKs strictly greater than compact maximum.
generic_sampling_rules.int_foreign_key_nullable: With probability 0.15 emit NULL; otherwise sample an existing parent primary key (compact or generated). Ensure at least one NULL row and at least one parent row with no child.
generic_sampling_rules.real_positive: Uniform real in [0.5, 500.0], rounded to 1 decimal; never NULL unless column nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.real_nullable: With probability 0.10 emit NULL; otherwise uniform real in [0.5, 500.0] rounded to 1 decimal.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Random string of 3-20 ASCII letters/spaces; with probability 0.10 emit NULL if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_date: Random date formatted 'Month D, YYYY' (e.g. 'March 14, 1988'); with probability 0.10 emit NULL if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.text_place: Random 'City, State' string; with probability 0.10 emit NULL if nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.near_variant: For LIKE-target columns, 20% of non-NULL values are near-variants of the listed literal (case change, trailing char, one-char substitution).
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_numeric: For numeric columns with listed LIMIT ties, place values exactly at the tie rank and one step (0.1) on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.duplicates_distinct: For DISTINCT-target columns, 30% of non-NULL values are duplicates of an earlier value.
generic_sampling_rules.group_size_mix: For GROUP-target columns, produce groups of size 1, 2 and >=3 across the generated rows.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: Nullable columns: 5-30% NULL rows per instance, at least one NULL row per nullable column; planted NULLs are never replaced to satisfy a rule.
